items.title: SSA-434797 V1.5 (Last Update: 2026-11-10): Buffer Overflow Vulnerability in OpenSSL affecting Siemens Products
items.summary: OpenSSL has published a stack based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to cause a denial of service (DoS) or potentially allow for remote code execution. Siemens has released new versions for several affected products and recommends to update to the latest versions.

items.title: SSA-392349 V1.3 (Last Update: 2026-11-10): Denial of Service Vulnerability in Industrial Devices
items.summary: Multiple industrial devices contain a vulnerability that could allow an attacker to cause a denial of service condition. Siemens has released new versions for several affected products and recommends to update to the latest versions.

items.title: SSA-390352 V1.1 (Last Update: 2026-11-10): Multiple Vulnerabilities in .NET Client Library for SIMATIC S7 Webserver API
items.summary: .NET Client Library for SIMATIC S7 Webserver API contains multiple vulnerabilities that could allow an attacker to obtain sensitive information or write arbitrary files outside the intended download directory.

items.title: SSA-282044 V2.1 (Last Update: 2026-11-10): DLL Hijacking Vulnerability in Siemens Web Installer used by the Online Software Delivery
items.summary: The installers used to install several Siemens products are affected by a DLL hijacking vulnerability. This could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code when a legitimate user installs an application that uses the affected installer component.

items.title: SSA-242944 V1.0: Node2Shell Vulnerability in Siemens Industrial Products
items.summary: On October 21, 2026, the Node.js project released security updates addressing a critical vulnerability in the Brotli decoder bundled with Node.js, commonly referred to as “Node2Shell” (tracked as CVE-2026-111497).

items.title: SSA-127084 V1.2 (Last Update: 2026-11-10): Multiple Vulnerabilities in Fortigate NGFW before V7.6.7 on RUGGEDCOM APE1808 Devices
items.summary: Fortinet has published information on vulnerabilities in FortiOS. This advisory lists the related Siemens Industrial products. Siemens recommends to contact customer support for additional information, and follow Fortinet advisory for workarounds and mitigation measures.

items.title: SSA-105852 V1.0: Out of Bounds Read Vulnerability in Simcenter Femap
items.summary: Simcenter Femap is affected by an out of bounds read vulnerability that could be triggered when the application reads files in X_T format. This could allow an attacker to crash the application or execute arbitrary code.

items.title: SSA-104023 V1.3 (Last Update: 2026-11-10): Multiple Vulnerabilities in Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS on RUGGEDCOM APE1808 Devices
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks has published [1] information on vulnerabilities in PAN-OS. This advisory lists the related Siemens Industrial products affected by these vulnerabilities. Customers are advised to consult and implement the workarounds provided in Palo Alto Networks’ upstream security notifications.
